caption:
"Be afraid of Allah, and be just to your children."

Sahih al-Bukhari 2587 - a father tries to give one son a gift, and the Prophet ﷺ won't let it stand until it's fair to all his children. Part of the Prophet's ﷺ guidance on how a man should be with his children. Swipe for Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Sahih al-Bukhari 2587, narrated by 'Amir (reporting An-Nu'man bin Bashir) - built for the requested topic 'how exactly should a man be with his new family, i.e. wife, children.' The narrative shows the Prophet ﷺ personally refusing to witness an unequal gift between a father's sons until the father agreed to be just to all of them - establishing fairness among children as a concrete, primary-text teaching rather than a general principle only inferred.
sourcing.arabic_and_english: Live-fetched and independently verified this session (2026-09-18) via mcp__workspace__web_fetch of https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2587 (HTTP 200), Gifts chapter, 'Chapter: The witnesses for the gifts', In-book reference: Book 51, Hadith 21, USC-MSA reference: Vol. 3, Book 47, Hadith 760. Arabic and English quoted verbatim from that page. Per this channel's methodology, the WebSearch AI-summary that first surfaced this reference was cross-checked against the actual sunnah.com page before use, and matched.
sourcing.grade: No separate Grade box is shown on sunnah.com for Sahih al-Bukhari hadith (Bukhari's collection carries inherent authenticity status by scholarly consensus, unlike the Sunan collections which sunnah.com grades individually).
sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese_malay: hadith-api (cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api) has NO Chinese, Korean, Japanese, or Malay editions for any hadith collection, confirmed via its editions.json this session.
